adapters.name: naive-join
adapters.approach: join the request onto the root and open it; no check, no retry

adapters.name: string-prefix
adapters.approach: lexically normalize, then check the path string starts with the root string

adapters.name: lexical-prefix
adapters.approach: lexically normalize, then check the path is beneath the root component-wise

adapters.name: canonicalize-then-open
adapters.approach: realpath the request, check it is beneath the root, then open the resolved path

adapters.name: open-then-verify
adapters.approach: open the path, then verify the handle's real location is beneath the root

adapters.name: beneath-strict
adapters.approach: openat2(RESOLVE_BENEATH); retry with the same method; refuse if unavailable

adapters.name: beneath-fallback-lexical
adapters.approach: openat2(RESOLVE_BENEATH); on unavailable or transient error, lexical check + plain open

adapters.name: beneath-fallback-walk
adapters.approach: openat2(RESOLVE_BENEATH); if unavailable, component-wise O_NOFOLLOW walk from the root handle
